verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting platform like FreeAgent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or tracking controls, or any opt-out setting. The invoice email toggles and OAuth docs are unrelated features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
